answer: The help center doesn't cover payoff numbers or how to get one, so please contact a store and they can help you sort this out with Harbor. If your loan is already paid off but Harbor is still listed on the title, ask Harbor for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign form NW-LRL-1 and we'll contact the lender for you, which can add 1 to 2 weeks.
